svg.aria-label: whoami: Abdulaziz Al-Matrafi, عبدالعزيز المطرفي. about: I started programming quite naturally. I kept coming across beautiful websites where people shared their ideas and turned what was in their heads into something creative, each in their own way. So I asked myself, why not start learning to code? I began experimenting with all kinds of things, just so my ideas could reach people in my own way. What I love most is the variety in creativity. Everyone has their own website and their own visual identity, and that's the beauty of it: you can stand apart from everyone else in your own way. I'm working on growing in project management and becoming professional in UI/UX. At the same time, I'm improving how I secure websites and how I make them scalable, so they can handle a huge number of visitors. Interests: full-stack web applications · software design · data structures · system analysis. Looking for: Opportunities to contribute to software development projects, collaborate with technical teams, and grow as a software engineer.
